stories.title: PCA Franchise Record — Breaks Billy Williams, Hits Two Homers

x_posts.label: Post 1
x_posts.text:
HR No. 43. That's when PCA broke Billy Williams' Cubs record for home runs by a left-handed hitter — a record that had stood since 1970.

Then he hit No. 44 in the same game.

3-for-4. 3 RBI. 3 runs. Cubs 8-4. Season: 44 HR / 37 SB.

#Cubs #GoCubs #FlyTheW

x_posts.label: Post 2
x_posts.text:

Three steals. That's all that stands between Pete Crow-Armstrong and the most exclusive club in baseball — six players in MLB history with a 40-40 season.

No Cub has EVER done this.
